experiments: off. B does not forbid extraDraw. Hard chooses extraDraw or next itself. settleLife and paidFront stay off. The new policy is not a menu item and the worker does not accept its name.
opening: Both arms clone one shared opening. The seed deals seat 0 then seat 1, the shared hard mulligan runs in first-player order, then LIFE is dealt.

metrics.extraDrawRate: Hybrid-seat idle start actions that are extraDraw, divided by extraDraw plus next.
metrics.deployAfterDraw: An own turn whose start action was extraDraw, and a later idle action that same turn is a front play or a raid. Compared with the same count after next. This is a description, not a pass gate.
metrics.apLeft: Ready AP cards at the end of each hybrid own turn, averaged per own turn.
metrics.firstFront: First hybrid own turn on which the front holds a character. Turns are counted when that seat enters an idle start.
metrics.firstRaid: First hybrid own turn with a raid.
metrics.firstConnect: First hybrid own turn whose attack reduces the opponent life count.
metrics.softClock: Wall time over 40 ms is reported. It is a soft deadline and is not a pass gate. A node count above 48 is a failure.

bootstrap: Paired difference is B wins minus A wins, divided by four, for each of the 40 seed blocks. An unfinished game is not a win. 1000 resamples, mulberry32(8970), percentile indexes 25 and 974.
